subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
If input impedances of the two circuits are given as R1 
and R2 respectively then 
 
(a) R1 = 2.5 k, R2 = 2.5 k 
 
(b) R1 = 2.5 k, R2 = 5 k 
 
(c) R1 = 500 k, R2 = 50  
 
 
(d) R1 = 500 , R2 = 500 
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-03 (Analog Electronics Practice Sheet 03).
